faq.a: Nazri is associated with the Arabic form نَذْرِي, whose core sense is nazri; of a vow (relative form) (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Nazri?
faq.a: Nazri is associated with Arabic. Nazri is the Malay form of Arabic نَذْرِيّ (Nadhrī), the relative form of نَذْر (vow), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form نَذْرِي is Arabic.
Nazri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nazri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nadhrī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Nazri mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nazri is rendered نذری and carries the sense نذری، نذر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Nazri mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nazri is rendered نذری and carries the sense نذری، منسوب به نذر.
A romanized syllable approximation is naz-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nazri?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nazri, nazri. Script forms are نذري, نذری, نَذْرِي, नज़री.

faq.q: Is Nazri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
